text: how to block tiktok on iphone (for real).
not screen time limits. those never work.
one tap on 'ignore limit' and you're back in. every time.
tiktok, instagram, whatever eats your day.
they only lock during the hours you set to focus.
the block holds until the block ends. that is the whole point.
i built the app that does this.
it is called ARCO and it just went live.

posts.title: i cut my screen time from 6 hours to 2
posts.caption: 6 hours a day is 8 full workdays a month. i did the math once and couldn't unsee it. no willpower involved — every hour got a job, and tiktok just won't open during my blocks. 3 weeks later: 2 hours, most of it useful. the planner and blocker are one app — ARCO, free on the App Store. #screentime #digitaldetox #appblocker #productivity #focus

posts.title: 5 apps i use to run my one-person app business
posts.caption: I build and ship iOS apps completely alone — no team, no office. These 5 make that possible. Claude writes most of my code now; Claude Code ships whole features while I review. ARCO is my own app and my operating system: every hour of the day gets a job, and TikTok stays blocked during focus blocks — planner and app blocker in one. Higgsfield generates every visual I post, including this one. RevenueCat runs my subscriptions so I've never touched a payment server. And Notion holds the roadmap, the content calendar, and every 2am idea. The tools aren't the point — the hours of uninterrupted focus they buy are. #aitools #appdevelopment #buildinpublic #indiedev #founder

posts.title: 5 apps i use to actually lock in
posts.caption: none of these are a secret. together they're the reason i finish things. claude explains whatever i'm stuck on — half my study time used to be searching, now i just ask. arco (my own app) plans the day and physically blocks tiktok during focus blocks, so the plan actually happens. google calendar holds the schedule — if it's not in there, it doesn't exist. notion remembers everything so my head doesn't have to. endel plays focus sound with no lyrics and no decisions. plan the hours, block the noise, start. #lockin #focus #productivity #studytok #screentime
